This notification is separate from the 355-post Non-HK recruitment. Candidates must possess PUC/Class 12 or an accepted equivalent qualification. Online applications begin on 23 November 2026. The probation period is 36 months, including training. Candidates should regularly check official websites for recruitment updates.

content_sections.heading: Karnataka Beat Forester Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: The Karnataka Forest Department follows a multi-stage recruitment process involving academic merit, physical fitness and written examination performance. Online application and eligibility scrutiny. Shortlisting based on PUC or equivalent examination marks. Physical Standard Test (PST). Physical Endurance Test. Physical Efficiency Test. Written Examination. Preparation of merit list. Original document verification. Final selection, medical verification and appointment formalities. Candidates are initially shortlisted for physical tests in a ratio of 1:20 based on their PUC or equivalent examination marks, subject to the applicable recruitment rules.

content_sections.heading: Karnataka Beat Forester Physical Standard Test 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must satisfy the prescribed physical measurements before proceeding to subsequent physical tests. Relaxed standards apply only to candidates meeting the specific eligibility and certificate conditions for the notified local forest-dweller category. Candidates must satisfy the prescribed eyesight, hearing and medical fitness requirements. The notice specifies distance vision standards of 6/6 in the better eye and 6/9 in the worse eye, with or without glasses. Disqualifying medical conditions specified in the notification include knock knees, bow legs, flat feet, varicose veins, specified speech or hearing impairments, hydrocele in men and disqualifying vision conditions. Candidates should read the complete medical and physical standards on pages 16 and 17 of the notification before applying.

content_sections.heading: Karnataka Beat Forester Final Merit List 2026
content_sections.text: The final merit calculation gives equal weightage to the candidate's PUC qualification marks and written examination marks. The physical tests are qualifying in nature. Candidates must clear the prescribed physical stages to become eligible for further selection. Final selection is subject to category-wise merit, available vacancies, reservation, eligibility and original document verification.

content_sections.heading: Karnataka Beat Forester Kalyana Karnataka Reservation 2026
content_sections.text: This notification covers vacancies under the Kalyana Karnataka cadre, formerly known as the Hyderabad-Karnataka region. Candidates claiming reservation as a Kalyana Karnataka local candidate under Article 371(J) must satisfy the prescribed local eligibility criteria. Eligible applicants must possess the relevant Kalyana Karnataka local-candidate certificate issued by the competent authority in the specified format. The notification also contains reservation provisions for SC, ST, OBC categories, women, rural candidates, Kannada-medium candidates, Ex-Servicemen, Sportspersons and other eligible categories.
